decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 92 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1009_AL(01)1000, 1009_AL(02)2000, 1009_AL(02)2001, Design and Access Statement, BRE Daylight and Sunlight Assessment, Sustainability and Energy Statement, Residential Noise Assessment, Heritage Statement, 1009_AL(05)5000, Fire Strategy statement received 17 January 20251009_AL(04)4000 ,1009_AL(04)400 received 24/03/2025) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - (a) The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy.
(b) Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the local planning authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions, and achieved a 65% reduction in emissions.
Reason: In order to ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until the applicant has entered into a binding arrangement with the Council to make an agreed contribution to the Council's Carbon Offset Fund, in accordance with the zero carbon strategy set out in the Energy Statement hereby approved to an amount that equates to the shortfall in required energy savings to meet the 'zero carbon' target.
Reason: In order to ensure the development meets sustainability standards.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) hereby approved, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources.

Condition : 8 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than two bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be installed in the rear garden. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: To support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 9 - The approved refuse and recycling store as shown on approved plan no. 1009_AL(04)4000 Rev. P02 shall be completed and made available for use before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, and thereafter shall be retained for such use at all times without obstruction. Bins shall be stored within the store at all times and shall not be left on the public highway.
Reason: In order to ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling.
description: Change of use of the existing ground floor from a beauty salon (Sui Generis) to a self contained studio flat (C3) with associated refuse & cycle storage and installation of a garden gate.
